finding: The Phase 1 thresholds were chosen on synthetic fixtures and are badly miscalibrated for real photographs. Whole-image clipping statistics are dominated by bright backgrounds and dark surrounds rather than by the produce, so SHADOW_CLIPPING and HIGHLIGHT_CLIPPING fire on most images. A meaningful capture gate needs the metrics restricted to a foreground region, which requires the segmentation that has not been implemented yet.
split: validation (development split; the frozen test split is never used for calibration)
